note: THE FIRST BUSHEL SOURCE, and the shape behind ten operators — seven of them CHS regions. Built 2026-08-21 from a real board captured live: fixtures/bushel-chsfarmersalliance.json, four locations and 24 rows of corn, soybeans and wheat. It took four discover runs to find, and the reason is recorded in lib/adapters/bushel.mjs: the signature matched Bushel by hostname and returned no identifying facts, so every Bushel response on a page collapsed into one and an 899-byte disclaimer config beat the 80KB board. locationId is the location's UUID because that is the key their payload uses and a display name is the thing a vendor re-cases. Read through a browser, like dtn-cs: their own page fetches the board at runtime and we hold no credential. ENABLED 2026-08-25. It had never been switched on, so it had never been given the chance to prove itself: a disabled source is not polled at all. The adapter was built against a real captured board (fixtures/bushel-chsfarmersalliance.json) and the suite exercises it, but the first LIVE read is the proof and that can only happen on the runner.
publicNote: Their publicly posted cash board, read from the same feed their own website reads. Cash and basis are their own commercial numbers. The futures quote is carried only so a consumer can re-check cash minus basis; it is not redistributed as a price feed.
